item.title: 269220 : I-71 North-South between MM 0.1 and 2.0 Between I-64/I-71 Interchange and Zorn Ave. in Jefferson County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : The I-71 widening and improvement project is a $50 million infrastructure investment to enhance safety and improve mobility along one of Louisville's most critical travel corridors. The two-year project, focused on increasing traffic capacity and safety, will enhance regional connectivity, provide reliable travel for years to come, and support economic growth. The project spans approximately two miles of interstate from the I-65/I-71 interchange near Frankfort Avenue to the I-71/Zorn Avenue interchange. Additional improvements include the construction of a multi-use path along Zorn Avenue between the I-71/Zorn Avenue interchange and Mellwood Avenue, as well as a new median treatment at the intersection of Zorn Avenue and Mellwood Avenue to enhance safety and better define traffic movements. The project also includes the demolition and reconstruction of the I-71 bridge over Beargrass Creek, along with a latex overlay on the I-71 bridge over I-64 at mile point 0.3 to extend the structure’s service life. For additional information, please visist https://transportation.ky.gov/DistrictFive/Pages/I-71-Widening---Louisville-.aspx.

item.title: 300565 : I-64 East-West between MM 53.0 and 58.0 Between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60 in Franklin County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight alternating lane closures on Interstate 64 East and West beginning Sunday, Aug. 16, in Franklin County. Overnight alternating lane closures will occur nightly from 7 p.m. through 6 a.m. beginning Sunday, Aug. 16, through Friday, Aug. 21, on I-64 East and West between mile markers 53 and 58 (between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60). The overnight alternating lane closures are necessary for contract crews to apply a concrete overlay to the I-64 bridges over U.S. 60 (Versailles Road), install shoulder rumble strips, perform pavement striping and place pavement markers. In addition to the overnight alternating lane closures on I-64 East and West, overnight alternating lane closures will be in place on U.S. 60 (Versailles Road) beneath the I-64 bridges at mile point 57.9 from 9 p.m. to 6 a.m. beginning Sunday, Aug. 16, through Friday, Aug. 21. Motorists are advised to follow all lane closure restrictions, use caution when traveling through the work zones, and plan for additional travel time. The work is part of the I-64 improvement project [links-1.govdelivery.com] between the Frankfort exits (mile markers 53 and 58), which includes milling removing the existing asphalt surface followed by resurfacing with new asphalt pavement. Other improvements to the 5-mile corridor include bridge repairs and bridge crash wall repairs. Construction is scheduled to be completed by the Fall of 2026. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. For the latest traffic and travel updates across the Commonwealth of Kentucky, visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com]. Information specific to District 5 counties is also available on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com].

item.title: 254857 : I-264 East-West between MM 21.5 and 22.9 Area of US-42 in Jefferson County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : UPDATE (March 23, 2026) – The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight lane and ramp closures on Interstate 264 East and West (Watterson Expressway) beginning Tuesday, March 24, as part of the $130 million widening and improvement project of I-264 and U.S. 42 (Brownsboro Road) [links-1.govdelivery.com]. Beginning Tuesday, March 24, at 8 p.m., through Wednesday, March 25, at 6 a.m.: Alternating lane closures will occur on I-264 East and West between mile markers 23 and 22 (from the I-264/I-71 split to U.S. 42/Brownsboro Road). Beginning Wednesday, March 25, at 8 p.m., through Thursday, March 26, at 6 a.m.: The I-264 East ramp to I-71 South will be closed. Motorists should continue on I-264 East, take I-71 North, then follow I-265 North to reconnect with I-71 South. Alternating lane closures will occur on I-264 East between mile markers 23 and 22 (from the I-264/I-71 split to U.S. 42/Brownsboro Road). Motorists should heed signage, use caution when traveling through the work zone, and plan ahead for travel delays. The highway improvement project is expected to be completed by the Fall of 2027. More details, including project timelines and traffic impacts [links-1.govdelivery.com], will be shared online as work progresses. Motorists are encouraged to sign up for email or text alerts [links-1.govdelivery.com] regarding weekly traffic impacts pertaining to the project.

item.title: 292980 : I-71/75 North Ramp to 12th Street/MLK Jr. Boulevard in Kenton County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : (June 5, 2026) – Interstate 71/75 ramp closures and detours in Covington are needed to safely advance construction on the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project, which will add interstate lanes, better access, a new companion bridge and convert the existing bridge for local travel to improve safety and increase regional highway capacity. Temporary closures and detours will now begin on Monday, June 8, and will take place in multiple phases. On Monday, June 8, the following closures are expected to take place: I-71/75 northbound off-ramp to 12th Street/MLK Jr. Blvd. (0.0 - 0.28 mile points): this closure will remain in place through Summer 2027. Detour: Traffic will use the I-71/75 northbound 5th Street exit ramp, turn left (north) onto Philadelphia Street, then left onto 4th Street driving west to the I-71/75 southbound ramp to Pike Street. Turn left on to Pike Street, then right on to Simon Kenton Way, then left on to MLK Blvd. KYTC will provide further updates ahead of the closures to inform all road users via the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor project website. [links-1.govdelivery.com] Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances. For the most current information on road construction in Northern Kentucky, please visit the District 6 Roadshow [links-1.govdelivery.com] or the Driving Northern Kentucky Progress [links-1.govdelivery.com] website. You can also stay informed by following KYTC District 6 on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com] (formerly Twitter). item.title: 301758 : I-71 South Ramp from KY 1039 in Gallatin County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : A widening project aimed at reducing congestion and improving safety on I-71 in Carroll and Gallatin counties is in progress. The project will widen I-71 from its configuration of two lanes in each direction, to three lanes. Ramp closures on I-71 northbound in Gallatin County are scheduled to begin at 8 p.m. on Sunday, Aug. 9. Crews will perform ramp work, including milling and paving operations, ramp widening and shoulder work. Due to the scope of work, these ramps will be closed continuously for an extended period during this phase of the project. A signed detour will be in place utilizing Boone Road (KY 465). The following ramps will be closed: -Exit 55 (KY 1039) on-ramp to I-71 southbound -I-71 northbound off-ramp to Exit 57 (Sparta Pike) Weather permitting, these ramp closures are expected to be in place through Sunday, Aug. 23. Additional updates will be provided if more time is needed to complete the work. Weather permitting, the overall project is expected to be completed Nov. 1, 2026. Learn more about the project here​ [links-1.govdelivery.com].

item.title: 301882 : I-64 West between MM 36.0 and 32.0 Between KY 53/Mt. Eden Rd and KY 55 in Shelby County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : As part of the $118 million widening and improvement project [links-1.govdelivery.com] in Shelby County, the Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of upcoming lane and ramp closures on Interstate 64 West beginning Wednesday, Aug. 19. The upcoming lane and ramp closures are necessary for contract crews to complete asphalt paving, striping, and the relocation of barrier walls for the next phase of the project. Once the operations are complete, westbound traffic will be shifted from the outside lanes to the newly constructed inside lanes as work advances. Beginning Wednesday, Aug. 19, through Friday, Aug. 21, overnight lane closures will be in place from 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. on westbound I-64 between Exit 32 (KY 55) and mile marker 36 (near KY 53/Mt. Eden Road). Following the nightly lane closures and paving operations, contract crews will shift westbound traffic from the outside lanes to the inside lanes throughout the project limits on Sunday, Aug. 23. The existing right lane will remain in its current configuration until the ramp transitions are complete to provide motorists access to KY 53 at Exit 35. Motorists should use caution, reduce speeds and be alert for changing traffic patterns throughout the work zone.

item.title: 301889 : I-275 East-West between MM 79.8 and 80.3 Area of Madison Pike in Kenton County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of an upcoming bridge maintenance project on Interstate 275 in Kenton and Campbell counties beginning Tuesday, Aug. 18. Contracted crews will perform in-depth concrete patching repairs on several bridge decks to improve roadway conditions and safety for motorists. These repairs involve saw-cutting damaged concrete in localized areas and re-pouring those sections to provide a long-lasting repair. The following traffic impacts are scheduled, weather permitting: Campbell County: Tuesday, Aug 18: I-275 eastbound over I-471 northbound and southbound (mile point 75.3 to 74.6) A single lane closure will begin at 6 p.m., followed by a double lane closure at 9 p.m. All lane closures will be removed by 6 a.m. Kenton County: Wednesday, Aug. 19 through Saturday, Aug. 22: I-275 over Madison Pike (KY 17) (mile point 79.8 to 80.3) Crews will begin work on the eastbound portion of the bridge before shifting to the westbound portion once repairs are complete. A single lane closure will begin at 7 p.m., followed by a double lane closure at 8 p.m. All lane closures will be removed by 5 a.m. The schedule may shift depending on weather conditions and the progress of repairs. Updates will be provided if the schedule changes. Motorists should anticipate some delays and are encouraged to find alternate routes. Weather permitting, this portion of the work is expected to be completed by 5 a.m. Sunday, Aug. 23. KYTC will advise if additional nights of work are needed. This project is part of a series of work focused on concrete repairs to improve conditions on interstate bridges in Boone, Campbell and Kenton counties. Additional information will be provided as work shifts to other local bridge overpasses. Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
